evidence.why: Tenant isolation is bound to a session-local Postgres setting (current_setting) rather than a server-verified claim like auth.jwt() tenant claim or a membership table; this value can be set by the connecting role/client proxy and is not cryptographically tied to the authenticated user.

The only check that would verify a user's membership in the claimed tenant is commented out, so tenant_id is accepted and stored without verifying the authenticated user actually belongs to that tenant.

controls_present: owner_id bound to auth.uid() in USING/WITH CHECK
